findings.problem: The title guarantees elimination of all stale reads, contradicting the supplied read contract, the modeled observations, and the qualified body and recap. Post-write deletion removes a fill completed during the write, but the overlapping read still returns the old value. An older snapshot can also fill the cache after deletion and make the next read stale. These modeled witnesses refute the guarantee under the supplied assumptions; they are not production measurements.

evidence.quote: db.read captures a snapshot when invoked, but its promise may fulfill after a later write commits.

edits.value: Post-write invalidation closes one stale-fill window
